videos.video_subject: Cristiano Ronaldo's father Jose Dinis Aveiro was the kit man at his first club Andorinha and died of alcohol-related illness in 2005 when Ronaldo was twenty, and Ronaldo points to the sky after scoring in his memory
videos.video_script: The kit man at his first club was his own father. Alcohol killed his father when Cristiano was twenty. Now every goal, he points at the sky.
